This directory contains an adapted computational-kernel extract from DebyeCalculator.
Upstream authors: Frederik L. Johansen, Andy S. Anker and contributors.
Upstream repository: https://github.com/FrederikLizakJohansen/DebyeCalculator
Source file: debyecalculator/debye_calculator.py
Git blob SHA-1: 89cd257ac681d3859457db7e8220cbc325c6953d
Retrieved through the GitHub connector on 2026-10-13.
Upstream license: Apache-2.0 (included).

MODIFICATIONS: extracted the forward grid/direct kernels into a small standalone
class; omitted GUI, file readers, atomic-factor tables, autograd/backward routines,
and progress callbacks. Shortened comments/docstrings. Added a separate wrapper
that builds element indices and returns the conventional full Debye sum
self + 2*unordered_pairs. The mathematical arithmetic of the selected forward
kernels follows the inspected upstream source. This is NOT a byte-identical
installation of DebyeCalculator and NOT an end-to-end test of its public API.
All supplied scattering factors, fixtures, statistics, tests and wrapper setup
are from the surrounding mof-debye-lab project.

Reference: Johansen et al., Journal of Open Source Software 9 (2024), 6024.
https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.06024
